question: What does a Before Regret home report check, and how does the year a house was built change the list?
verdictConfirmed: 2026-11-24: the report's Inspect list comes from 20 fixed rules in src/engine/inspectionPriorities.ts, each with a build-year window and, for some, a state or county list. No AI writes a report. Year built is what the visitor types and is not verified.
demand: tier 3 for the brand: topic-demand.ts 2026-11-24 (captures 2026-11-24-demand-before-regret-gsc / -bing) found zero Google impressions for 'before regret' in 16 months; Bing showed the homepage 6 times. Owner-directed brand page (2026-11-24). No volume is stated on the page.

ourWork.sampleText: Cook County, IL (no regional gating): built 1925 -> 11 items (3 check first); 1955 -> 12 (4); 1968 -> 12 (4); 1985 -> 9 (2); 2000 -> 7 (0); 2015 -> 4 (0); 2024 -> 4 (0). Roof and HVAC age items apply to homes built 2014 or earlier (12+ years old in 2026).
observations: Live report rep_1795500810677, generated 2026-11-24 for 1414 Mission Street, South Pasadena, CA 91030 (City Hall's public address), entered as a single-family home built 1925: 12 things to inspect (3 check first, 7 worth checking, 2 lower priority), 6 questions for the seller, 5 records to pull yourself, 1960 typical year built nearby (census tract) vs 1965 county median, and 1 insurance item (knob-and-tube). Its sources list names 13 sources, 5 of them marked checked live for every address.

Same report, Records to pull yourself: Roof Replacement Permit Records, Main Electrical Service Panel, HVAC Compressor & Mechanical System, FEMA Flood Hazard Risk Zone, Municipal Code Enforcement Standing; each links to an office or record rather than a result.

Same report, The neighborhood section: Census tract figures (typical year built, median owner costs, median home value, owner-occupied share, mean commute, primary heating fuel) labelled as figures for the census tract, not measurements of the house.

facts.claim: The report states that the year built is what the visitor gave and is not verified.
facts.quote: The year built is the one you gave us; we haven't verified it.

facts.claim: The report's records section says those records were not checked for the address.
facts.quote: These 5 records were not checked for this address. Each links to the official source for this area, so you can look it up before you sign.

facts.claim: Neighborhood figures are tract figures, not measurements of the house.
facts.quote: Census figures for this neighborhood (census tract), not measurements of this house.

facts.claim: Seller answers are not checked by Before Regret.
facts.quote: Answers are not checked by Before Regret; get anything important in writing.

facts.claim: The About page says no AI writes any part of a report.
facts.quote: No AI writes any part of a report: everything in it comes from those lookups and fixed rules for a home's age, county and property type.
Ask your own carrier whether they will write a policy while it is still energized. Rules vary by carrier and state.
